import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Identify top drivers based on t-statistics
    driver_scores = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        t_stat = abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, i], feats.x[feats.y==0, i]).statistic)
        driver_scores.append(t_stat)
    
    # Select top 4 drivers
    sorted_indices = np.argsort(driver_scores)[::-1][:4]
    drivers = [feats.ids[i] for i in sorted_indices if driver_scores[i] > 1.0]
    
    # Use only top drivers as columns to keep model small
    columns = drivers.copy()
    
    # Create products only between the drivers themselves
    products = []
    for i, a in enumerate(drivers):
        for b in drivers[i+1:]:
            products.append((a,b))
    
    # Create loadings for weighted score using drivers
    loadings = {}
    for fid in drivers:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        t_stat = abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, col_idx], feats.x[feats.y==0, col_idx]).statistic)
        loadings[fid] = t_stat
    
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple(drivers),
        columns=tuple(columns),
        products=tuple(products),
        loadings=loadings
    )
